common_instruction: State what is observed versus proposed; use source-appropriate versions and avoid inventing execution results.

cases.name: Reloading without lifecycle enabled
cases.prompt: A Prometheus rule update passes promtool check rules, but curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload returns 403. Explain how to safely activate new rules and confirm they loaded.
cases.trap: Assumes HTTP lifecycle reload is enabled on every Prometheus server.
expectations: Names --web.enable-lifecycle as prerequisite for HTTP reload or an authorized SIGHUP/service manager reload.
Checks Prometheus config and active loaded rule state; does not claim a 403 is success.
must_not: Does not say the reload endpoint always works without configuration.
